_note: Entries ops/reachability-check.py may not fail on. Read that file's header first: a tombstone is an explicit intentional-not-wired MARK, not a mute button. It must carry a reason and a reopen condition, it must name something still in the tree, and it stops applying — and becomes the finding itself — the moment its entry becomes reachable. Adding one is a decision to be made in the pull request that adds it, in words, not a way to get a red check green.
_seeded: 2026-08-23, from the completion-integrity council's fix D. Every entry below was found by the check's first run against main and is a real gap, not an artefact. None is fixed here on purpose: grok's fix-D procedure is 'mark gaps not-landed, do not remediate mid-sweep', and every one of these remediations is somebody else's call — Joe's for a blocking hook, the fleet's for a service declaration. What the check buys today is the ratchet: no NEW unwired control can enter the tree without an argument for it.

tombstones.reason: Unreachable as a hook, but NOT an unbriefed session, and the difference is a settled ruling this check cannot see. On 2026-08-08 Joe settled the zero-file fork (decision 3f634c5a — 'the bootstrap stub dies too'): the session briefing lives on THREE surfaces — the MCP server's `instructions` field, which is universal and carries the standing-context opening act on every client; the Cowork project field; and a SessionStart hook that briefs live from the store. This file is the third leg. hooks/worktree-self-plumb.py records in its own header that it 'is wired ONLY into the two VAULT project settings', and those two files are a mirror bin/sync-settings.sh retired, whose live originals are no longer on this Mac. So the hook leg runs nowhere while the universal leg still briefs every session — which is why ops.enforcement_control_catalog records session_boot as installed=false and nothing broke.
tombstones.reopen_when: the hook leg is either restored on a SessionStart surface that still exists (ops/config/hooks.json is the one the repository manages) or retired deliberately, with the two surviving surfaces named as what replaces it.
